title: mariposa lutea
intro: Mariposa lutea, commonly known as Mexican gold poppy or Fiddlenecks, is a perennial wildflower native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering several health benefits including pain relief, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mariposa lutea include analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as insomnia and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
